notes: Vol2 NIST Gaithersburg building 101 HVAC cooling. [RE-KEYED 2026-10-03 from the render] Page 12: INDOOR AIR CONDITIONING UNIT SCHEDULE ACU-A-1 to ACU-A-6, built-up air handlers whose row names each one's scheduled return fan, supply fan, filter, coils and humidifier: AHU 6 (no family reads this title; the only built-up use of it in the corpus, every other AIR CONDITIONING UNIT title being a split system); SUPPLY FAN SCHEDULE S-A-1 to S-A-6; HEATING COIL SCHEDULE HC-A-1 to HC-A-6. Page 13: COOLING COIL SCHEDULE CC-A-1 to CC-A-6 (with the heating coils, DUCT_MOUNTED_COIL 12); RETURN FAN SCHEDULE E-A-1 to E-A-6 (the ACUs' return fans) and E-A-7, E-A-8, E-A-13 (toilet, mechanical room and sub-basement exhaust): with the supply fans, FAN 15; HUMIDIFIER SCHEDULE H-A-3. Not keyed: the FILTER SCHEDULE's F-A-1 to F-A-6 (the ACUs' filter sections) and the STEAM TRAP SCHEDULE. Page 17: three DDC INPUT/OUTPUT POINT SCHEDULEs (ACU A-3,4,5,6: 23 rows; ACU A-1: 19; ACU A-2: 17) print one device per row, ticked under INPUT TO DDC / OUTPUT FROM DDC, ANALOG / BINARY columns (a row often ticks several, e.g. a fan status sensor's airflow, status and speed), DDC FEATURES and GENERAL: bas_points rows 59, the rows that tick an input or output column; types, alarms and trends not keyed. Each table's unit label row (AIR CONDITIONING UNIT (ACU A-1) ...; ACU A-3,4,5,6's ticks COLOR GRAPHICS only) is not a point; the takeoff counts them (62). The earlier key (FAN 6, no ACUs, BAS 0) predates the return fan and points reads.
